$$

$$

We now write our integral in terms of $u,$ calculate the integral as normal, and write the final answer in terms of $x$ at the very end:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int 48(3x-7)^{7}\,\text{d}x & =\int 48{u}^{7}\cdot \frac{1}{3}\,\text{d}u \\  & =48\cdot \frac{1}{3}\int {u}^{7}\,\text{d}u \\  & =16\cdot \frac{{u}^{8}}{8}+C \\  & =2\cdot {u}^{8}+C \\  & =2(3x-7)^{8}+C\end{aligned}
$$

Let's double-check that our result is correct. If we differentiate the result, then it should come out to the original integrand:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}[2(3x-7)^{8}+C] & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}[2(3x-7)^{8}]+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(C) \\  & =16(3x-7)^{7}\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(3x-7)+0 \\  & =16(3x-7)^{7}\cdot 3 \\  & =48(3x-7)^{7}\,✓\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy :question/answer-fields ["aa23e206-e2c7-5918-8bd9-348e98fbec24"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "f75603bf-fe81-50c1-9321-dc5b1249a827" :answer/id #uuid "f75603bf-fe81-50c1-9321-dc5b1249a827" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\frac{1}{2}(3x-13)^{8}+C" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "20d2ad2c-fb89-58a7-8091-651be6dd4bbd" :answer/id #uuid "20d2ad2c-fb89-58a7-8091-651be6dd4bbd" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "16(3x-13)^{8}+C" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "376db25a-fc5f-5042-8c89-64bba6c97f11" :answer/id #uuid "376db25a-fc5f-5042-8c89-64bba6c97f11" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "8(3x-13)^{8}+C" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "44984ed3-c9b5-5cf7-8d1e-15b7fd85d79d" :answer/id #uuid "44984ed3-c9b5-5cf7-8d1e-15b7fd85d79d" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\frac{3}{2}(3x-13)^{8}+C" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "1a9f23ca-cacc-5e1e-abb5-55c7d3a45c54" :answer/id #uuid "1a9f23ca-cacc-5e1e-abb5-55c7d3a45c54" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "2(3x-13)^{8}+C" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "839b108c-5fff-581b-9e63-b66af5e351b0" :answer-field/id #uuid "839b108c-5fff-581b-9e63-b66af5e351b0" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/choices ["f75603bf-fe81-50c1-9321-dc5b1249a827" "20d2ad2c-fb89-58a7-8091-651be6dd4bbd" "376db25a-fc5f-5042-8c89-64bba6c97f11" "44984ed3-c9b5-5cf7-8d1e-15b7fd85d79d" "1a9f23ca-cacc-5e1e-abb5-55c7d3a45c54"] :answer-field/correct "1a9f23ca-cacc-5e1e-abb5-55c7d3a45c54" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "45e3bd8b-7650-5cda-96ec-8c1136f22506" :question/id #uuid "45e3bd8b-7650-5cda-96ec-8c1136f22506" :question/problem "$\int 48(3x-13)^{7}\,\text{d}x=$" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=3x-13.$ Then differentiating with respect to $x$ gives
